result.summary: Found 1 significant layout issue in the restaurant details.

issues.description: The metadata beneath “Tokumaru Ramen Bar” overlaps: the delivery-time and delivery-fee text are rendered on top of each other, making the line unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Fix the metadata row spacing and width calculations. Use a properly spaced flex or wrapping layout so time, delivery fee, separators, and cuisine never overlap.
